To address this issue, a semi-supervised approach is proposed, which utilizes unlabeled data to fine-tune a model, leading to improved performance.  Furthermore, a novel method for generating pseudo-labels from unlabeled data is introduced, which enables the semi-supervised approach to function effectively.  To validate the efficacy of this method, a large dataset of 1,000,000 unlabeled bird images was created and compared with other state-of-the-art approaches.  The results demonstrate that this method achieves superior accuracy, with a top-1 accuracy of 92.6% and a top-5 accuracy of 96.4% on the CUB-200-2011 dataset, outperforming existing benchmarks. Despite recent breakthroughs, the current VQA systems are limited by their inability to provide explanations for their answers, making them unreliable and vulnerable to errors.  To address this issue, researchers have proposed the use of Visual Explanability Question Answering (VEQA), a more robust approach that requires models to generate explanations for their answers.  In this study, we introduce a new dataset, the Explanability VQA dataset, designed to evaluate the ability of AI models to provide accurate explanations for their answers.  To ensure the dataset's effectiveness, we have implemented a rigorous annotation process, resulting in a comprehensive dataset with 20,000 questions and explanations.  To the best of our knowledge, our dataset is the first of its kind, and we have developed a novel evaluation metric to assess the performance of AI models on this task.  Our experiments demonstrate that the current state-of-the-art VQA models struggle to provide accurate explanations for their answers, highlighting the need for more research in this area.  To address this challenge, we have proposed a new model, the Explanability-aware VQA model, which outperforms the current state-of-the-art models in both question answering and explanation generation.  Our study provides valuable insights into the development of more robust VQA models and sheds light on the potential applications of VEQA in real-world scenarios.
